evidence.title: ogimagecn - Beautiful OG images, made simple
GitHub - shadcn-labs/ogimagecn: Beautiful Open Graph image components, built on Satori

name: ogimagecn
summary: shadcn registry of copy-paste React components for Open Graph images, built on Satori.
description: Copy-paste Open Graph image components for React, built on Satori and distributed through the shadcn CLI. Install a block into an ImageResponse and get a social card; every component is a single self-contained TypeScript file you own, previewable live in the browser. Sets cover brand, content, product and shadcn-registry cards, with a playground customizer, PNG download and a platform scan.
contains: 22 registry items installed with the shadcn CLI
blocks for brand, content, product and shadcn-registry cards
base components: avatar, badge, brand mark, divider, grid lines, waveform
zero dependencies; each component is a single TypeScript file
playground customizer with PNG download and a platform scan
